header.description: Outputs of the original Java code (compat="original"), bugs and crashes included. See tools/reference/README.md and tests/fixtures/golden/README.md.
header.isolation: all cases of a file run in one JVM; each case builds a fresh game, has its own captured stdout/stderr and catches every Throwable. Under -XX:hashCode=2 every identity hash is 1, so this equals one fresh JVM per case (checked by regen_golden.sh).

order_dependence.method: each file was also run under the alternative identity-hash settings below; expected.order_dependent[field] is true iff some alternative changed that field
